### [Interactive solar and shading study](https://jinggling09.github.io/solar-studie.html)
A private, AI-assisted learning project on energy renovation: explore solar position and building self-shading using a provisional 3D model. Fictional reference location; illustrative panels only, no energy-yield forecast.

[View demo](https://jinggling09.github.io/solar-studie.html) · Updated: 1 November 2026 · German introduction, English controls

### [Germany climate dashboard](../wissen/emissionen-de.qmd)
Interactive analysis of the national GHG inventories of the German Environment Agency: total emissions against the Climate Protection Act target path, sector trends and sector shares. Updated automatically from the UBA DataCube.

[Live]{.status} · [Code](https://github.com/jinggling09/germany-climate-dashboard)
:::
